text:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: Dedicated pool dpool-12 (region: us-west-2) reporting 100% GPU util and 120 queued requests. Tenant: ACME_Corp (tenant-id: acme-01). Autoscaler attempted 0->1 nodes, hit tenant cap. Paging Alice.

alice (oncall): on it. pulling metrics.

carla (sre): I see elevated prefix cache misses; queue length spiking around 12:03 UTC.

bob (infra): autoscaler logs show "tenant_quota_exceeded" when trying to provision gpus. ACME has reserved 8 GPUs, pool used=8.

alice (oncall): can we burst to shared pools? what's policy?

dan (runtime): burst is allowed if tenant has "allow_burst" flag; currently false for acme-01. Also need to ensure model pinning to avoid noisy neighbors.

alice (oncall): ok. @amanda can you confirm if ACME approves temporary burst to shared pool? this will use extra capacity and we may bill them.

amanda (acct): checking with ACME SRE now. they care about isolation — will approve only if we restrict to smaller models and avoid their private data hitting other tenants. also want ETA and confirmation of rollback. pls keep me posted.

carla (sre): We can enable burst + model whitelist. Proposal: allow burst up to 4 GPUs on shared pool spool-3, restrict models to 'gpt-small' and 'gpt-medium', and enable KV-cache-only fallback for long contexts.

bob (infra): operational steps:
1) set tenant flag allow_burst=true
2) create routing rule: tenant=acme-01 -> prefer dpool-12, fallback spool-3 with weights
3) apply model whitelist

Command to set flag (internal API):
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/tenants/acme-01/flags -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"allow_burst":true}'
```

dan (runtime): also need to patch autoscaler to ignore tenant_quota for burst requests (internal override). I can roll a one-line change to allow override --burst-override for ops-bridge.

ops-bridge: deploying burst-override patch to autoscaler canary now.

incident-bot: deploy job started: autoscaler/canary/2026-03-15T12:15Z

bob (infra): I'm ready to flip routing once amanda confirms. also prepping ephemeral firewall rule to enforce model egress constraints.

amanda (acct): ACME SRE approves burst for up to 4 GPUs for next 90 minutes. they want autoscaling logs and assurance of rollback.

alice (oncall): got approval. proceeding to enable.

carla (sre): enabling tenant flag and routing. will apply model whitelist and set max_burst=4.

alice (oncall): running commands now.

carla (sre): applied flag and routing. config snippet:
```
tenant: acme-01
allow_burst: true
max_burst_gpus: 4
fallback_pool: spool-3
model_whitelist: ['gpt-small','gpt-medium']
```

dan (runtime): autoscaler canary applied, override in effect. starting gradual route weight shift 90% dpool-12 -> 70/30 dpool-12/spool-3.

alice (oncall): monitored queue length: dropping from 120 -> 40 in 7m. GPU util normalize ~70% on dpool and ~55% on spool-3.

bob (infra): observed one pod eviction on spool-3 due to memory peaks; adjusted pod limits. no customer compute loss reported.

amanda (acct): ACME acknowledged burst is helping. requesting timeframe and notes for billing.

alice (oncall): telling finance to capture extra 4 GPU-hours. tagging bill: acme-01/burst/2026-03-15.

ops-bridge: recording incident note: "tenant acme-01 exhausted dedicated pool dpool-12; temporary burst to spool-3 enabled with model whitelist; no data exposure; 4 GPUs used; rollback scheduled at +90m"

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: queue drained below 5, latency normalizing.

alice (oncall): marking mitigated. initiating controlled rollback in 15m unless re-spike.

carla (sre): scheduled rollback at 13:45 UTC. will remove allow_burst flag and routing fallback.

dan (runtime): prepping rollback commands. also creating postmortem ticket in #postmortems with CC to eng-runtime and product.

alice (oncall): handing off to bob for next shift: summary -> acme-01 exhausted dedicated pool due to bursty eval jobs; we enabled temporary cross-tenant burst (4 GPUs) to spool-3 with model whitelist; queue drained; rollback scheduled; customer approved; billing flagged.

bob (infra): ack. i'll watch for re-spike and ensure rollback runs cleanly. pls add any leftover logs to the ticket.

ops-bridge: end of active incident. tagging severity: SEV2 (customer impact, degraded throughput) :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED at 1834005200. Follow-up: postmortem assigned to eng-runtime/ACME_burst_postmortem.

alice (oncall): adding quick notes for postmortem: root cause = unbounded eval job from ACME SRE hitting reserved capacity; mitigation options: (1) proactive quotas per-tenant for eval workloads, (2) auto-burst opt-in with pre-signed billing agreement, (3) model-level computation caps.

carla (sre): + action: add alert for "tenant nearing reserved cap" at 80% with direct notify to acct manager.

bob (infra): + action: add autoscaler improvement to allow controlled queue draining via preemptible burst without full tenant override.

amanda (acct): thanks team. please include cost estimate and timeline in the postmortem so ACME can reconcile.

alice (oncall): will add estimated 4 GPU-hours and timeline. handing off to next oncall.

bob (infra): final ack. closing thread.
